Drove 6hrs to Sequoia National Park and did not see a single “site”, not a single popular hike, nothing. Just connecting with myself, friend, and my boys. Also our campsite was at Hume Lake, so the views were spectacular. Esp since there was not a single other person in our immediate campgrounds bc apparently everyone else cancelled their reservation bc of the hail forecast, of which it was maybe 30 mins worth. I really need to do this more. Next up- solo camping with Colt and Archie! #camping #

2.5 weeks ago, after feeling burnt out, I felt the need to recenter myself so my friend and I booked an impromptu trip to go camping in Sequoia last minute and it was so invigorating to be deep in nature where there is no cell service or internet and just connect with myself again and spend quality time with the ones I love. I didn’t do any of the amazing hikes, I spent the time “finding myself again” and I’m so thankful that I did. Honestly I wish I took more photos and videos but I was too bus
